login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Enter your email and we will send you a single-use sign-in link, valid for 15 minutes.
login.sent: If the email has an active account, you will receive a sign-in link shortly. Please also check your spam folder.
login.lead: AI-assisted written interviews with the staff of organizations certifying with the efr model. The auditor chooses the sample, validates doubtful answers and approves the report.

dev.text: No email integration: sign in with this link. It can be used once and expires in 15 minutes. If the email has no active account, no link is shown.

verify.chooseOrgHelp: Your email has accounts in several audit entities. Which one do you want to enter?

users.created: User created. We have notified them by email.

campaigns.title: Audits

warnings.OPENS_IN_PAST: The window starts in the past: check the interview start date.
warnings.START_NOT_BUSINESS_DAY: The start date is not a business day: the window opens on the next business day.

campaigns.aggregateHint: As coordinator you see the status and aggregate progress. The sample, codes and answers are only for the responsible auditor.
campaigns.maximumHint: When this number of completed interviews is reached, the audit closes automatically.
campaigns.maximumAboveSample: The maximum ({{max}}) exceeds the people in the sample ({{n}}): add people to the sample to be able to reach it; otherwise the audit will close when the window ends.
campaigns.scheduledHint: Scheduled audit: it will open by itself on {{opens}} and the invitations will go out. Until then you can edit it and replace the sample.

campaignForm.efrManagerHint: Coding reference only; the AI never mentions it
campaignForm.languagesHint: Only languages approved by the Fundación will be offered.
campaignForm.previewEmpty: Fill in the date, size and norm to see the minimum, window and questions.
campaignForm.howTitle: the minimum and the window are computed by the system
campaignForm.howText: The current minimums table and business days (Monday to Friday) apply, in the organization's time zone. The window opens on the interview start date and lasts 10 business days. AI plays no part in these calculations.
campaignForm.organizationHint: Only the organizations assigned to you as auditor
campaignForm.noOrganizations: You have no organizations assigned. Your audit coordinator must assign one before you can create the audit.
campaignForm.interviewStartDateHint: The window opens that day and lasts 10 business days
campaignForm.maxCompletedHint: Empty = the minimum. When it is reached, the audit closes automatically.
campaignForm.wellbeing: Includes the Well-being component (questions P11 to P15)

sample.title: Sample
sample.intro: Download the template, fill it in without names or identifying data and upload it. If there are errors nothing is loaded.
sample.uploadAppend: Add people to the sample (Excel or CSV)
sample.errorsTitle: The file has {{n}} errors. Fix them and upload it again.
sample.smallGroups: Groups with fewer than 3 people (re-identification risk):
sample.codesHelp: To hand out on paper to people without email. The row refers to your file.
sample.fileHint: Excel (.xlsx) or CSV, up to 5 MB

brand.sideNote: For organizations with a valid efr certificate.

participant.title: enter your code
participant.intro: Type the 8-character code you were given on paper. Your answers are confidential.
participant.codeHint: No spaces. Upper or lower case does not matter.
participant.notFoundText: This link does not match any interview. Check the address you were given.
participant.notOpenNoDate: The interview is not open yet.
participant.noticeAi: The interview is written and led by an artificial intelligence that only asks the questions and organizes your answers; it makes no decisions about you.
participant.noticePurpose: Purpose: to learn the staff's opinion for the audit of the efr work-life balance certificate.
participant.noticeConfidential: It is confidential: we will not ask your name and your company will never see who answered or what.
participant.noticeAbstain: You can skip any question with “I'd rather not answer”.
participant.noticeContact: If you have questions, ask the auditor who gave you the code.
participant.startWhenOpen: You can start when the interview opens, using this same code.
participant.completedText: You have already answered the interview. Thank you for taking part!
participant.closedText: The deadline to answer this interview has passed.
participant.unavailableText: The interview is not available at the moment. Please ask the auditor.

entities.title: Audit entities
entities.intro: Certification bodies that audit efr companies. Each one has coordinators, who assign auditors to the organizations.
entities.name: Entity name
entities.coordinatorEmailHint: A coordinator account will be created and notified by email

entityAuditors.title: Auditors of the entity
entityAuditors.intro: Create and deactivate the auditor profiles of your entity. Then assign them to your organizations.

myOrgs.title: My organizations
myOrgs.introCoordinator: Organizations assigned to you by Fundación Másfamilia. Designate the responsible auditor for each one; you can assign yourself.
myOrgs.introAuditor: Organizations assigned to you. From here you can create the audit for each one.
myOrgs.reassignHint: When the auditor changes, open audits move to the new auditor and the change is recorded.

assignment.title: Assignment
assignment.intro: Audit entity and coordinator responsible for this organization. The coordinator designates the auditor.

progress.title: progress

alerts.SAMPLE_BELOW_MINIMUM: The sample has fewer people than the minimum of completed interviews ({{minimum}}).
alerts.PROJECTION_BELOW_MINIMUM: At the current pace about {{projection}} interviews would be completed at the close, below the minimum ({{minimum}}). Consider a reminder or extending the window.

progress.peopleHint: Each person is identified by their row in your sample file; their email and answers are never shown.

interview.expiredText: The session has expired. Open the link in your email again or type your code: you will continue where you left off.
interview.ownWords: Or answer in your own words
interview.doneText: Your answers have been saved confidentially. You can now close this page.
interview.multiHint: You can choose several options; then press «send».
interview.conversationHint: Answer in your own words. If something isn't clear, just ask.

results.sectionHint: Tables calculated from the completed interviews, queue of doubtful answers and individual answers.
results.title: Results
results.pendingAlert: There are {{n}} answers waiting for review: they do not count in the percentages until you decide.
results.howCalculated: Calculated by the platform, never by the AI, from the completed interviews. Percentages are over the valid answers (without abstentions, invalid or pending answers) and shown with one decimal.
results.bySexAndAge: Distribution by sex and age band
results.notAsked: Not asked in any completed interview.
results.outsideCondition: {{n}} outside the condition of the question
results.multiNote: Multiple choice: percentage of people mentioning each option; the sum may exceed 100%.

review.title: Answer review
review.confidentiality: Confidential: these are individual answers. Use them only to code them; every access is recorded. Who answered is not shown.
review.emptyPending: There are no answers waiting for review.
review.empty: There are no answers in this view.

responses.title: Individual answers
responses.notice: You are about to see each person’s answers together with their demographics. This is confidential audit information.
responses.notice1: Neither the email nor the sample file row is shown, and rows do not follow the order of the interviews.
responses.notice2: This access is recorded with your user, the date and the IP address.
responses.notice3: If a group has fewer than 3 people, someone could be identified: you will see a warning.
responses.legend: In bold, answers decided in the review. Hover over the code to see the question.
responses.commentsNote: Shown apart, without demographics and not in interview order (dissociated free text).
